The aim of this trial was to investigate the safety and efficacy of GC101 via intrathecal injection in SMA type 1 patients. # Treatment of SMA type 1 infants using a single-dose AAV9-mediated gene therapy via intrathecal injection of GC101: An open-label, single-arm study Publication date: [pub-type: epub] Day: 09 Month: 7 Year: 2024 Publication date: [pub-type: ppub] Day: 20 Month: 8 Year: 2024 Volume: 137 Issue: 16 Issue: [pub-id-type: pmc-issue-id] 469056 First page: 1976 Last page: 1978 Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), a neurodegenerative disorder caused by mutations in survival motor neuron 1 (SMN1) resulting in reduced expression of the survival motor neuron (SMN) protein, is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. SMA type 1 is the most frequent subtype of SMA characterized by onset before 6 months of life, inability to achieve independent sitting, and rapidly progressive respiratory and bulbar deterioration, causing a mortality of >90% before 2 years of age.^{[[ref-type: bibr] 1]} Currently, there have been two lifelong splice-modifying therapies (nusinersen and risdiplam), and a single-dose gene replacement therapy via intravenous onasemnogene abeparvovec for SMA type 1 patients, approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA).^{[[ref-type: bibr] 2]} Here, we developed recombinant adeno-associated virus serotype 9 (AAV9) containing codon-optimized human SMN1 (co-SMN1) complementary DNA (GC101) driven by cytomegalovirus (CMV) enhancer and chicken β-actin promoter with the attributes of high titer, low endotoxin, low aggregation, and a low empty capsid rate. Knowing that the degeneration and death of α-motor neurons in the spinal cord and brainstem are major manifestations of the disease, and that the AAV9 vector would not only reach the motor neurons directly but could also pass the blood–brain barrier^{[[ref-type: bibr] 3]} before reaching the peripheral tissues, it seems possible that intrathecal injection of GC101^{[[ref-type: bibr] 1]} could have a favorable benefit-risk profile. The aim of this trial was to investigate the safety and efficacy of GC101 via intrathecal injection in SMA type 1 patients. This open-label, single-arm, phase 1 clinical trial of gene-replacement therapy was conducted in the Department of Pediatrics, the Seventh Medical Center of PLA General Hospital (Beijing, China). The study was done in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki, International Council for Harmonisation and Good Clinical Practice guidelines. The study protocol and informed consent forms were reviewed and approved by the Ethics Committee of the Hospital (S2021-003). Written informed consent was obtained from all parents or guardians of the patients before study participation. The redacted study protocol is available at Chictr.org.cn (ChiCTR2200056833). GC101 was administered as a one-time intrathecal injection of 2.4 × 10^{14} vector genomes [vg] per infant. The details of the inclusion and exclusion criteria, treatments, outcomes, and statistical analysis are listed in Supplementary Methods and Table 1, [ext-link-type: uri] http://links.lww.com/CM9/C76. Briefly, patients should be diagnosed as SMA type 1 with age ≤12 months. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 厦门特宝生物工程股份有限公司　募集说明书摘要 (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-07-24/1225439628.PDF) citeturn163search13 [wordlim: 200] Published: 3 months ago; Crawled: 3 months ago; SKG0201 I 型脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA） 用于慢性肾功能不全导致的贫血 已完成Ⅱ期临床研究，正开展Ⅲ期临床研究相关准备工作 1,374.85 1,827.37 1,700.04 SKG0201 I 型脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA） 开展Ⅰ期临床研究相关准备工作 967.31 - - SKG1120 遗传性视网膜疾病（RP） 临床前研究阶段 801.00 - - ACT400 慢性乙肝临床治愈 开展药学和临床前研究 798.20 971.24 - ACT560 慢性乙肝临床治愈 开展药学和临床前研究 757.98 - - ACT60 过敏性呼吸道疾病 开展药学和临床前研究 757.61 931.33 870.50 派格宾用于治疗原发性血小板增多症项目 原发性血小板增多症（ET） -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- FAQ Vesemnogene for SMA (https://www.icare.com.my/pdf/smaFAQ.pdf) citeturn163search14 [wordlim: 200] Published: 1.5 years ago; Crawled: last week; FAQ Vesemnogene lant uparvovec for SMA, version 3.0 1 June 2025 FAQ Vesemnogene lant uparvovec for SMA, version 3.0 1 June 2025 # FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ) ## Vesemnogene lant uparvovec rAAV9-SMN1 gene therapy ## for Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) # Contents 01 INTRODUCTION ........................................................................................................1 02 WHO CAN AND HOW TO GET THE TREATMENT? ................................................2 03 UNDERGOING TREATMENT & IIIMEDIATE POST-TREATMENT CARE ........3 04 AFTER TREATMENT CARE BEFORE RECOVERY: CHEST HEALTH ..............5 # 01 INTRODUCTION
# Questions Answer
1. What is this new gene therapy Vesemnogene lant uparvovec for SMA? Is it the same as Zolgensma? Vesemnogene lant uparvovec consists of rAAV viral vector to deliver a normal copy of the SMN1 gene (rAAV9-SMN1) to treat SMA, just like AdV the viral vector in the AstraZeneca or CanSino vaccines which deliver the SARS-CoV2 spike protein gene to induce an immune response (vaccination). -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The evolving therapeutic landscape of spinal muscular atrophy – A scoping review of investigational agents, emerging delivery technologies and strategic innovations (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13206266/) citeturn163search1 [wordlim: 200] Published: 8 months ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; NCT06971094 (last updated on June 5, 2025; GeneCradle Inc.; started May 27, 2025; completion by December 31, 2026) is an ongoing, multi‐centre Phase III clinical trial in China evaluating the safety and efficacy of GC101 among patients with SMA type 2 who previously received long‐term treatment with nusinersen. ... ChiCTR2500095667 (last updated on January 10, 2025; GeneCradle Inc.; started on January 18, 2025; completion by December 2030) is an ongoing, single‐centre Phase I/II clinical study evaluating the safety, tolerability and preliminary efficacy of GCB‐001, another gene‐replacement therapy delivered by a self‐complementary AAV9 vector that carries a functional SMN gene cassette, among patients with SMA type 2 in China. NCT06421831 (last updated on July 3, 2025; GeneCradle Inc.; started May 10, 2024; completion by December 2028) is an ongoing, Phase I/II clinical trial in multiple centres in China, evaluating the safety and preliminary efficacy of GC101 among patients with SMA type 3. ^{56} The study is enrolling approximately 21 participants aged ≥2 years, each with genetically confirmed bi‐allelic SMN1 deletions and baseline HFMSE scores between 10 and 54. Participants should have not received nusinersen within 120 days or risdiplam within 15 days prior to dosing, free from significant comorbidities, and have AAV9 neutralizing antibody titres <1:200. Patients are excluded if they have high ventilatory support requirements (≥16 h/day), need for enteral feeding, severe bodily contractures and any clinically significant systemic disease or prior gene‐therapy exposure. All participants receive a single intrathecal injection of GC101 at 1.2 × 10^{14} vector genomes (vg). The primary outcome is the incidence of treatment‐emergent AEs. Key efficacy outcomes include changes in HFMSE and RULM scores and the proportion of participants achieving a increase in HFMSE score by ≥3‐point at Month 12. NCT06971094 (last updated on June 5, 2025; GeneCradle Inc.; started May 27, 2025; completion by December 31, 2026) is an ongoing, multi‐centre Phase III clinical trial in China evaluating the safety and efficacy of GC101 among patients with SMA type 2 who previously received long‐term treatment with nusinersen. ^{49} The trail aims to enrol around 50 participants who meet the following inclusion criteria: genetically confirmed 5q‐SMA, ability to sit independently but inability to walk, a baseline HFMSE score ≥ 10 and continuous nusinersen therapy for >1 year prior without recent risdiplam use <2 months before enrolment and no planned use <12 months after. Exclusion criteria include abnormal liver function, contraindications to glucocorticoid use and lumbar puncture, a serum anti‐AAV9 neutralizing antibody titres >1:50, severe comorbidities (e.g., epilepsy, infections, CSF circulation disorders) and with recent vaccination or gene therapy exposure. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 股票代码：688278
